1911.04252.title: Self-training with Noisy Student improves ImageNet classification
1911.04252.mechanism: self-training in which an equal-or-larger student is trained on pseudo-labels produced by a teacher, with noise injected into the student during learning

1903.07785.title: Cloze-driven Pretraining of Self-attention Networks
1903.07785.mechanism: a bi-directional transformer pretrained by cloze-style reconstruction: each word is ablated and predicted from the remaining text

2003.10580.title: Meta Pseudo Labels
2003.10580.mechanism: the teacher is no longer fixed: it is adapted by feedback from the student's performance on the labelled set, so pseudo-label generation is itself learned rather than frozen

2203.05482.title: Model soups: averaging weights of multiple fine-tuned models improves accuracy without increasing inference time
2203.05482.mechanism: average the weights of models fine-tuned under different hyperparameter configurations, which lie in a single low-error basin, instead of selecting the single best and discarding the rest

2205.01917.title: CoCa: Contrastive Captioners are Image-Text Foundation Models
2205.01917.mechanism: one image-text encoder-decoder pretrained jointly with a contrastive loss and a captioning loss, with cross-attention omitted in the first half of the decoder so those layers encode unimodal text

2010.05006.title: Automated Concatenation of Embeddings for Structured Prediction
2010.05006.mechanism: search automatically over which pretrained embeddings to concatenate for a given task, instead of fixing the concatenation by hand

2006.01563.title_note: not resolvable through the channels available here; the Papers With Code model name is used in its place
2006.01563.mechanism: extend the BERT input with neighbouring sentences and combine the several predictions each token then receives by contextual majority voting

2010.01057.title: LUKE: Deep Contextualized Entity Representations with Entity-aware Self-attention
2010.01057.mechanism: treat entities as first-class tokens alongside words, pretrain by masking both, and extend self-attention with an entity-aware term that conditions on whether each token is a word or an entity

2003.08237.title: Fixing the train-test resolution discrepancy: FixEfficientNet
2003.08237.mechanism: correct the mismatch between the image resolution seen in training and the one seen at test time, rather than changing the architecture or the training data
